Inflation has rebounded from negative figures observed since 2023 [C013]. By August 2024, year-on-year inflation stood at 0.5 percent, with a 12-month average of -0.9 percent [C064], while September core inflation was -0.4 percent year-on-year [C024]. 

For the outlook, year-on-year inflation is projected to reach 2.5 percent by end-2024 (with annual inflation at 0.5 percent) and stabilize around 3 percent in the medium term [C006], [C064], [C136]. Inflationary pressures are expected to increase in 2025 [C136].

These dynamics are driven primarily by increases in utility tariffs, domestic currency depreciation, and the unwinding of lower global fuel prices [C013], [C006], [C064].
